name: unclutter
description: Collapses tool results (MCP included) to one line; a click opens the full call in a side pane

expandedTools.title: Tools shown in full
expandedTools.description: Comma-separated tool names whose results are never collapsed

followLatest.title: Pane follows the latest tool call
followLatest.description: When on, an open tool call pane switches to each new tool call; when off, it keeps showing the call it was opened on. Toggle in-session with f in the pane or /tool-pane-follow

highlightColor.title: Highlight background
highlightColor.description: Background of the call shown in the pane: auto picks one for your dark or light theme, or give a color name or hex such as #3b4252
